TVPCacheControl.description: Specifies the caching strategy to be used for the response.

x-enumDescriptions.NO-CACHE: Travelport cache will be bypassed and live availability results returned.
x-enumDescriptions.PERCENT-50: Cache will be used if at least 50 percent of the properties / rates are found. Response will be PARTIAL if less than 100 percent found. Response will be HIT if 100 percent found. When less than 50 percent of the properties / rates are not found a live search of all page 1 properties will take place with re-caching of rates. User accepts higher response time as consequence of this header choice.Response will be MISS
x-enumDescriptions.PERCENT-75: Cache will be used if at least 75 percent of the properties / rates are found. Response will be PARTIAL if less than 100 percent found. Response will be HIT if 100 percent found. When less than 75 percent of the properties / rates are not found a live search of all page 1 properties will take place with re-caching of rates. User accepts higher response time as consequence of this header choice. Response will be MISS

x-enumDescriptions.Standard: Basic property classification offering essential amenities without luxury features.
x-enumDescriptions.Tourist: Properties catering to leisure travelers, often located near attractions and offering affordable rates.
x-enumDescriptions.Unknown: Used when the property’s segment classification is not specified or cannot be determined.
x-enumDescriptions.Upscale: Properties offering enhanced amenities and service, typically rated 4 stars and above.
x-enumDescriptions.Upper upscale: A higher tier of upscale properties, often close to luxury in terms of service and amenities.

roomDescription.example: Complimentary WiFi, 49-inch TV, mini-fridge, work desk, ergonomic chair. Relax in this stylish 22 sq. m. /237 sq. ft. King Room. Enjoy a restful night's sleep in the luxurious Suite Dreams® by Serta bed. Work in comfort at the desk with ergonomic chair. Watch a program on the 49-inch LCD TV or surf the web with complimentary WiFi. This room also features a mini-fridge, adjustable air-conditioning, coffee/tea maker and an iron/ironing board to make you feel at home. Stay connected to the office with our 24-hour business center, which provides complimentary printing, fax and copy machines.
